text:
ash_support: Support -> CS handoff for MeridianAI trial. Onboarding stuck: bulk ingest failing with intermittent 502 and embedding similarity down ~22%. Trial activation slipped to 24%. Sales has a check-in in 5 days. Need CS to lead a bridge + a short customer-friendly update.

 tom_se: Reproduced on tenant. Issue started after a config rollout that enabled aggressive prefetching; prefetch is overflowing the ingest workers and causing 502s. I've disabled tenant-prefetch and queued a rollback to stable config. Internal ticket 10824.

 priya_csm: I'll take the customer lead and set up the bridge. Can someone paste a one-paragraph non-technical blurb I can send now? Scheduling 30m at 9am PT. @harry_csm_dir FYI 9 if we don't stabilize, prepare renewal mitigation options.

 harry_csm_dir: Acknowledged. Prep mitigation: (1) 1-week extension, (2) account credit if outage >24h, (3) prioritized enablement. Priya, capture NPS-like sentiment on the bridge.

 tom_se: Customer-facing snippet: "We're pausing a recent config change that affected your ingest pipeline and applied a temporary stabilization. Expect improvements within ~30 minutes; we'll review live on the bridge."

 ash_support: Logs pushed. Short extract for call: `ingest::502 "upstream_error" at 2026-05-10T08:12:10Z`, `embed_delta: base 0.89 -> 0.69 after rollout`.

 ops_bot: Incident 10824 created and escalated to CS. Priority: P2. Bridge scheduled: 2026-05-10T09:00:00-07:00. Eng oncall paged.

 priya_csm: Thanks. Owners: immediate customer note = Priya, tech on-call & RCA on bridge = Tom + Ash, post-call remediation & renewal play = Harry. I'll send the invite and an apology note now.

 tom_se: Rollback snippet for runbook: ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal/api/admin/rollback -d '{"tenant":"meridian","target":"stable-config"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
```

 ash_support: Invite sent; joining early to stream logs. Will add a brief timeline after we see metrics in 30m.

 priya_csm: After the bridge I'll update the renewal flag and attach a short post-call survey link to capture feedback. :handshake:
